_comment: SCALABLE design: ONE shared Genie Space + ONE UC row filter (rls_firm_filter) keyed on current_user(); per-firm service principals mapped in demos.genie_rls.entitlements. The agent routes by the TRUSTED tenant_id (custom_inputs) -> reads that firm's OBO token (secret-backed env var FIRM_TOKEN_<firm>) -> calls Genie as that SP. Scales to N firms with N entitlements rows + N SPs, no per-tenant Spaces. SP tokens are provisioned/rotated by scripts/provision_sps.py.
